STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether Mr. Y.M. Punchibanda who has served as a bus driver of the Teldeniya Depot of the Sri Lanka Transport Board had been causedinjustice by termination of his services with effect from 23.02.2008, the date from which his services had been temporarily suspended,through letter No. Y%S ,x.u/udil/lï' in/fmdÿ/2015 dated 01.10.2015 of the Sri Lanka Transport Board and if so, to what releifs he isentitled.

STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether the non- payment of arrears of salary for the period from 31.08.2012 to 29.12.2012, the period during which the service ofMr. M.A. Jayantha who worked as a Conductor of the Mathugama Depot of the Sri Lanka Transport Board had been interdicted, and hisservice being temporarily suspended for 01 month from 09.05.2013 to 08.06.2013 and being transferred to Horana Depot without beinggranted the one day leave requested by him for in accordance with Appeal order No.Y%S,x.u/fyd/md/71/2013 dated 08.05.2013 following theconduct of a disciplinary inquiry against him are just and equitable and if not so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
M. D. C. AMARATHUNGE,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo this 28th day of March, 2017.
